clips.title: The story
paras: Malfurion Stormrage lies in a coma within the Emerald Dream, beyond the reach of his people. The first mortal druid and revered leader of the night elves beside High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, he helped defeat the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients and the Third War. The kaldorei honor him as Shan'do, or honored teacher, and await his waking guidance.

Malfurion Stormrage turned from the arcane to nature ten thousand years ago. Before the Great Sundering broke ancient Kalimdor, he studied under the demigod Cenarius. As Queen Azshara and her Highborne delved into the Well of Eternity's arcane power, Malfurion became Azeroth's first mortal druid. His fears proved true when Azshara's sorcery tore open a way for Sargeras and the Burning Legion, beginning the War of the Ancients.

Malfurion Stormrage helped drive the demons back and close the portal above the Well of Eternity. He fought beside Cenarius, Tyrande Whisperwind, and his twin brother Illidan. After the world shattered, Malfurion led the druids into the Emerald Dream to rebuild and protect Azeroth's living world. Ten thousand years later, Tyrande woke him to face Archimonde in the Third War. At Mount Hyjal, he rallied the forest spirits and shattered the Burning Legion once more.

Malfurion Stormrage returned to sleep in Moonglade after the Third War, seeking the Emerald Dream and strength for his spent power. His spirit never returned to his body, leaving him in an unnatural coma. In Darnassus, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm carries the Cenarion Circle's duties of leadership. Tyrande and the sisterhood watch for their Shan'do to wake.
